diagnosis: The plot shows roughly 1,320 contacts with slack below \(10^{-11}\), exceeding the \(250\times5=1{,}250\) tangent degrees of freedom, so the configuration is first-order jammed and LP/LSE polishing can only produce tiny gains inside the same active-set basin. There are no rattlers to remove, while contact degrees vary unevenly from about 3 to 17 against a mean near 10.6, indicating an amorphous, non-uniformly stressed contact graph rather than a balanced regular one. The projected contact graph likewise shows no obvious symmetry, orbit, shell, or repeated local motif. Progress has therefore decayed because recent methods repeatedly re-polish the same topology; the missing structural property is a different, more regular contact topology—potentially with near-uniform positive dual stresses or an underlying algebraic/symmetric organisation—that small kicks and LP steps cannot reach.
